### Detailed Findings

#### Perspective: Magnification & Reflow (HIGH)

**Finding:** Thumbnail grid uses fixed 32×32px dimensions with a 2px gap, preventing content from reflowing to a single column at narrow viewports and causing text/button overlap when scaled to 200%.
**WCAG:** 1.4.4 Text Resize, 1.4.10 Reflow
**Perspective:** Magnification & Reflow
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Visual Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `gallery.css` lines 9–11: `.thumb-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, 32px); gap: 2px; }` and lines 14–16: `.thumb-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; ... }`
**Fix:** Replace fixed pixel dimensions with relative units (e.g., `minmax(80px, 1fr)` or `clamp()`). Allow the grid to reflow naturally and ensure interactive elements scale without overflow when text is resized.

---

#### Perspective: Keyboard & Motor Access (MEDIUM)

**Finding:** Lightbox dialog lacks a focus trap; pressing Tab will escape the modal to page content behind it, breaking `aria-modal="true"` expectations and trapping users who rely on keyboard navigation within modals.
**WCAG:** 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, WAI-ARIA APG Modal Pattern
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** CRITICAL
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (primary) (secondary: UX Design)
**Evidence:** `ImageGallery.jsx` lines 38–42: `useEffect` adds a global `keydown` listener for Escape but does not implement focus cycling within `.lightbox-content`.
**Fix:** Implement a focus trap using `tabindex="0"` on the dialog container or JS to cycle focus between close, prev, next, and zoom buttons when Tab/Shift+Tab is pressed inside the dialog.

**Finding:** Close button (`×`) and zoom controls (`+`/`−`) are sized at 16px and 20px respectively, falling below the 24×24px minimum target size for touch and motor accessibility.
**WCAG:** 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Visual Design (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `gallery.css` lines 35–37: `.lightbox-close { width: 16px; height: 16px; ... }` and lines 58–60: `.zoom-btn { width: 20px; height: 20px; ... }`
**Fix:** Increase minimum dimensions to 24×24px (or 44×44px per WCAG AAA guidance). Adjust padding/margins accordingly without breaking layout.

**Finding:** Zoom controls use single-character symbols (`+`, `−`) as visible text while relying on `aria-label` ("Zoom in", "Zoom out") for screen reader/voice control compatibility. This violates the requirement that visible label text matches accessible name for voice control users.
**WCAG:** 2.5.3 Label in Name
**Perspective:** Keyboard & Motor Access
**Severity:** MINOR
**Route to:** Content Author (primary) (secondary: Front-End Dev)
**Evidence:** `ImageGallery.jsx` lines 68–71: `<button ... aria-label="Zoom in">+</button>` and `<button ... aria-label="Zoom out">−</button>`
**Fix:** Replace symbol-only visible text with explicit labels ("Zoom In", "Zoom Out") or ensure the accessible name is exposed visually for voice control compatibility.

---

**Component/artifact reviewed:** Image Gallery With Undersized Touch Targets
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Magnification & Reflow (HIGH), Keyboard & Motor Access (MEDIUM)
